summary: The record shows recurrent transient focal neurological symptoms followed by an emergency attendance for a suspected acute right hemispheric infarct, with NIHSS 8 and CT excluding intracranial haemorrhage. This is a serious acute event requiring clinical follow-up, but the snapshot does not document post-event prognosis, persistent disability, progressive life-limiting disease, repeated admissions, escalating dependency, or an active advance-care plan. A palliative or goals-of-care conversation should not be initiated solely from this snapshot; a human clinician should first establish the acute outcome and current function, then reconsider a priorities-focused discussion if prognosis or unmet needs warrant it.
